256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

133-accept.name: Abercrombie
133-accept.text:
I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
133-accept.title: Ghoulish Effigy

156-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-complete.text:
Good,  you got the rot blossoms.  And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons.

Keeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in Duskwood is welcome news indeed.
156-complete.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

159-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
159-accept.text:
Here's your Zombie Juice...

...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!
159-accept.title: Juice Delivery

159-complete.name: Abercrombie
159-complete.text:
A thousand thanks, $N.  You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!

Here you are, friend.  Take this as a token of my gratitude.
159-complete.title: Juice Delivery

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

173-complete.name: Calor
173-complete.text:
Impressive, $N. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.

It is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
173-complete.title: Worgen in the Woods

178-complete.name: Theocritus
178-complete.text:
You have my gratitude, $N.  I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure.  But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.

In time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.

But before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.
178-complete.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

178-progress.name: Theocritus
178-progress.text: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say?  Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
178-progress.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

219-complete.name: Marshal Marris
219-complete.text: You have served the Kingdom well, $C.  Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs.  You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
219-complete.title: Missing In Action

221-accept.name: Calor
221-accept.text:
You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

Be on your guard.
221-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

346-accept.name: Brother Paxton
346-accept.text: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron.  Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
346-accept.title: Return to Kristoff

346-complete.name: Brother Kristoff
346-complete.text: That's the one!  Thank you, $N.  May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
346-complete.title: Return to Kristoff

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-complete.name: Brother Paxton
347-complete.text:
Oh, splendid!  I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

Thank you, $N!
347-complete.title: Rethban Ore

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

79092-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79092-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79092-complete.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92489-accept.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

95-complete.name: Unknown
95-complete.text: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
95-complete.title: Sven's Revenge
